title: From a full disk to an upstream fix
description: A cleanup failure in our Elixir integration, a fix from SmolVM's maintainer, and the tests that closed the loop. A small story of contributing to open source.
image_alt: From a full disk to an upstream fix: reproduce the failure, fix the deletion order, and verify cleanup and the next execution.

title: When the sandbox fails: testing SmolBox with nested KVM
description: What disk exhaustion, worker OOM and a frozen VM taught us about resource limits, execution records and recovery in an Elixir application.
image_alt: When the sandbox fails: a Linux host supervises a disposable worker environment running SmolBox and nested SmolVM machines.

title: Introducing SmolBox: managing SmolVM executions from Elixir
description: Why we chose SmolVM and how SmolBox manages execution identity, outcomes, and cleanup from Elixir, with a runnable Python example.
image_alt: An Elixir application submits an identified command to SmolBox, which manages a SmolVM worker and a disposable Python VM.
